visualReview.notes: All13 current portable views inspected. Unequal pointed primary vaults and three lower passages remain open. Final revision adds masonry to the passage jambs and supporting walls below the mapped approaches. Both entrances remain open and cobbled paving follows the south bend.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All13 current shared-surface views inspected. Raw mineral sandstone/basalt and fired clay preserve the geometry-defined tuff repair pattern and brick levelling bands. Rounded cutwater bases and inner vault surfaces show no missing faces. Placement, shared material resolution and unload assertions pass.

geographicReview.notes: Exact Q3107472 mapped perimeter and signed north-northeast axis are bound in source-local map-frame evidence. The new footprint evidence overlay follows that same local frame. Published80m main body and mapped92.429m approaches are kept distinct. Actual Hrazdan bed and bank fit still require approval.

fidelityReview.notes: 746,998-triangle original reconstruction of the November2025 restoration, based on ministry dimensions and current2026 photos. Includes two pointed main vaults, three lower passages, brick levelling courses, individual red/charcoal stone faces, preserved basalt repair panels, moulded arch rings, curved cutwaters, drainage outlets, parapets, complete paved and supported approaches. Individual stone locations and hidden foundations are interpreted; no measured survey is claimed.
